name: dsh-bilimemory
description: DSH Cordis plugin for local BiliMemory. Run bilimemory_doctor before use and start the backend at 127.0.0.1:8765. Requires DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2+, Windows 10/11, Node.js 22.19+, Python 3.12, Playwright/Edge, FFmpeg, Bilibili login, local embedding at 127.0.0.1:11435, and MaiBot/NapCat for QQ. Provides Bilibili status, collection, search, task and login tools plus QQ status, allowlist and restart tools. The repository includes a Windows one-click installer that installs or repairs MaiBot A-Memorix when missing, configures local-bge-small-zh and shared memory scope. Voice, RVC, MeloTTS, raw-vocal and song-cover features are excluded.
